largeheadline_copy_c.line1:
SILVERGlide
Bipolar Forceps
largeheadline_copy_c.line2: Our SILVERGlide family of non-stick bipolar forceps is designed to address the issue of tissue adhesion and thermal damage during surgery. We offer a wide range of SILVERGlide forceps to meet your surgical needs.

text.text:
Non-stick, no hassle

SILVERGlide's patented silver plating is designed to prevent tissue buildup and adhesion. Instead of stopping to scrape the tips, a quick wipe with a moistened surgical sponge keeps the tips clean. Clean tips keep procedures flowing smoothly without interruption and let you use lower power settings to achieve the same surgical results.1

text_copy.text:
The gold standard in silver plating

SILVERGlide is a proprietary technology that reduces molecular bonding force and eliminates hot spots on the forceps tips. The SILVERGlide alloy defuses heat 37 times better than standard stainless steel—and lab tests and field experience show that this exceptional non-stick performance remains unchanged even after multiple uses.1

text.text:
SILVERGlide Irrigating

The bayonet-style Irrigating series features an innovative hollow-tine design that brings irrigation exactly where you need it—to the tip of the forceps. Separate fluid and electrical connectors accept a wide variety of cord-tubing sets. The forceps’ guidestop keeps tips aligned, reduces scissoring and helps with overall dissection.

SILVERGlide ProSeries

The ProSeries enhances the features you love—non-stick silver plating and guide-stops for reduced scissoring and better control—with thinner tines, longer length and slimmer handles that enhance access, visibility and comfort in the delicate applications and smaller incisions of minimally invasive procedures. Choose from straight or bayonet style in six lengths.

text.text:
SILVERGlide accessories

We have a full range of accessories to help your SILVERGlide forceps deliver optimal performance and flexibility.

  • Reusable cable—sturdy silicon rubber wire with SnugShield feature for a secure electrical connection
  • Disposable cable—sturdy PVC rubber with SnugShield feature for a secure electrical connection
  • Sterilization trays—two piece, five piece and 10 piece
  • Polishing cloths
  • Tip guards

“The SILVERGlide forceps don’t char or stick, and because of this are extremely accurate in their application of energy. They’ve proven to be one of the best equipment purchases I’ve made.“

Mark Glasgold, M.D. | Highland Park, New Jersey

1.bullet: Five product lines—the perfect forceps for every application

3.bullet: Maximum visibility—microgauge tines provide clear view of tissue

6.bullet: Light, balanced ergonomic handle design for comfort and visibility
